title: Corner C3 - Room Zoom Transition Spec
summary: How zooming into a room feels. Animation curves, HUD behavior during zoom, detail levels, mobile pinch-zoom.
content:
Corner C3: Room Zoom Transition Spec

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. The zoom is the magic moment. When you click a room and it fills your view, that's when Corner feels like a world.

Zoom Levels

Three distinct levels. Each reveals more detail.

Level 1: Overview (Default on load, or after pressing O)

  • Scale: 0.7x (or 1.0x per Steve's spec, Bobby has 0.7x for overview. Use Bobby's 0.7x.)
  • What's visible: All 13 rooms + Main Hall. The full L-shaped building.
  • Detail shown:
    • Room backgrounds (flat or render)
    • Agent nameplates (name + status dot)
    • Agent characters (small, ~20px, idle pose)
    • Active agent glow (pulsing dot)
    • CORNER entrance sign
  • Detail hidden:
    • Furniture details (too small to read)
    • Ambient animations (performance)
    • Speech bubbles
    • Agent hover task text

Level 2: Neighborhood (Click a room)

  • Scale: 1.6x (Bobby's current default, it's good)
  • What's visible: The clicked room + 2-4 neighboring rooms at the edges
  • Detail shown:
    • Everything from Level 1 +
    • Furniture details visible (desks, monitors, plants)
    • Ambient animations playing (server blinks, coffee steam, LED breathing)
    • Agent characters larger (~36-40px)
    • Hover: shows task text in nameplate
  • Detail hidden:
    • Rooms beyond neighbors dimmed to 30% (darker than the 40% inactive dim)
    • CORNER sign may be off-screen depending on which room is centered

Level 3: Room Detail (Double-click or pinch-zoom)

  • Scale: 2.8x-3.0x
  • What's visible: Single room fills ~60% of viewport
  • Detail shown:
    • Everything from Level 2 +
    • Full furniture detail (monitor screen content readable, book colors on shelves)
    • Agent character at full detail (~56-64px)
    • Speech bubble visible when agent is speaking
    • Nameplate hidden (agent is obvious at this zoom)
    • Room personality fully readable (individual furniture items, wall decorations)
  • Detail hidden:
    • All other rooms completely hidden or barely visible at extreme edges
    • HUD collapses to minimal mode (see HUD Behavior section)

Transition Animations

Level 1 to Level 2 (Click Room)

  • Duration: 400ms
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.0) (fast start, gentle landing)
  • What happens:
    1. Scale transitions from 0.7x to 1.6x
    2. Camera pans to center the clicked room (translate X/Y)
    3. Both scale and translate animate simultaneously (not sequentially)
    4. Non-neighboring rooms fade from 40% to 30% brightness (200ms, starts at 200ms into the zoom)
    5. Mini-map fades IN (it was hidden at Level 1)
    6. Furniture detail fades in (opacity 0 to 1, starts at 300ms, 200ms duration)

Level 2 to Level 3 (Double-Click or Scroll Zoom)

  • Duration: 350ms
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1.0) (same as above, consistent feel)
  • What happens:
    1. Scale transitions from 1.6x to 2.8x
    2. Camera re-centers on the room (may need slight X/Y adjustment)
    3. Neighboring rooms slide off-screen or fade to 20%
    4. Nameplate fades out (it's redundant at this zoom)
    5. If the room has a pixel art render, the detail becomes crisp

Level 3 to Level 1 (Click Background / Esc / Overview Button)

  • Duration: 500ms (slightly slower for the "pulling back" sensation)
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0.0, 0.2, 1.0) (slow start, fast exit)
  • What happens:
    1. Scale transitions from 2.8x to 0.7x
    2. Camera resets to center-all position
    3. All rooms fade back to normal brightness (40% idle, 100% active)
    4. Mini-map fades out
    5. Nameplates fade in
    6. This should feel like lifting off in a helicopter. Satisfying pullback.

Level 2 to Level 2 (Click Different Room)

  • Duration: 600ms (Bobby already has this, keep it)
  • Easing: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) (Bobby's current, it's smooth)
  • What happens:
    1. Camera pans to new room (translate only, scale stays 1.6x)
    2. Previous room's brightness dims back to 40%
    3. New room's brightness rises to 100%
    4. Mini-map camera dot slides to new position

Scroll Wheel Zoom

Continuous zoom between levels (not discrete jumps).

  • Sensitivity: 0.15x per wheel tick (scroll up = zoom in, down = zoom out)
  • Min scale: 0.5x (slightly beyond Level 1, shows the whole building with padding)
  • Max scale: 3.5x (slightly beyond Level 3, for pixel-peeping)
  • Easing on each tick: 200ms ease-out (micro-transitions feel smooth)
  • Debounce: no debounce on the scale, but debounce the detail-level switching (don't flicker furniture on/off during fast scrolling)

Detail Level Thresholds

Scale Range Active Detail Level
0.5x - 1.0x Level 1 (overview)
1.0x - 2.2x Level 2 (neighborhood)
2.2x - 3.5x Level 3 (room detail)

Transitions between detail levels use the same fade animations but triggered by crossing thresholds, not by click events.

HUD Behavior During Zoom

Level 1 (Overview)

  • Task HUD bar: visible, full functionality
  • Chat bar: visible, collapsed (56px)
  • Mini-map: hidden (full view is already the mini-map)

Level 2 (Neighborhood)

  • Task HUD bar: visible, full functionality
  • Chat bar: visible, collapsed or expanded
  • Mini-map: visible, bottom-left, shows camera position
  • Clicking the agent character at Level 2 opens the chat bar focused on that agent

Level 3 (Room Detail)

  • Task HUD bar: COLLAPSES to a slim 36px bar (just CORNER. logo + mode switcher icons, no tabs)
  • Chat bar: visible, can expand. Chat opens focused on the room's agent.
  • Mini-map: visible, more important here (user can click mini-map to jump elsewhere)
  • The reduced HUD gives maximum viewport to the room detail

HUD Transition on Zoom

  • HUD bar height: 48px -> 36px when entering Level 3 (200ms ease)
  • Tab labels fade out, icons remain (150ms)
  • On leaving Level 3: reverse animation

Mobile Zoom (Touch)

Pinch to Zoom

  • Standard two-finger pinch gesture
  • Same scale range (0.5x - 3.5x)
  • Momentum: when fingers release, scale continues for 100ms at the release velocity, then decelerates

Tap Room to Zoom

  • Single tap on a room: zoom to Level 2, camera centers on room
  • Double-tap on a room: zoom to Level 3
  • Tap empty space (outside rooms): zoom to Level 1

Pan While Zoomed

  • One-finger drag to pan when zoomed to Level 2 or 3
  • Momentum scrolling (finger release continues pan with deceleration)
  • Boundary clamping: camera can't pan beyond the building bounds + 20% padding

Camera Momentum (Desktop, Mouse Drag)

When zoomed to Level 2 or 3:

  • Click and drag the game viewport to pan
  • On release: pan continues with decaying momentum
    • Initial velocity: match the drag speed at release
    • Deceleration: multiply velocity by 0.92 per frame (60fps)
    • Stop when velocity < 0.5px/frame
  • Boundary clamping: same as mobile

Bobby already has the static translate. Adding momentum is a CSS/JS enhancement on the existing system.

The zoom is how Corner becomes a world instead of a dashboard. Fast in, smooth pan, satisfying pullback. Bobby builds this in Step 6.
